name: db-safegraph
what_it_holds: NYC Mayor's Office of Data Analytics ETL pipeline for ingesting SafeGraph data into a city database (NYC Planning fork also exists: NYCPlanning/db-safegraph). Pipeline/infra code only, no committed foot-traffic CSVs (SafeGraph access is licensed to the city).
why_useful: Confirms municipal-government SafeGraph pipelines exist for NYC (a market already in the Inside Airbnb panel) but the underlying data itself is not public through these repos.
themes: Public-health and mobility indices: Google/Apple mobility archives, Cuebiq, SafeGraph/Advan/Dewey samples, Placer.ai-like foot traffic, mobility datasets by city
why_all: Confirms municipal-government SafeGraph pipelines exist for NYC (a market already in the Inside Airbnb panel) but the underlying data itself is not public through these repos.

name: cbeddow/overture2osm
what_it_holds: MIT tools (5 stars, updated 13 Sep 2026) converting Overture Maps Foundation data to OpenStreetMap tags/formats -- similar purpose to whubsch/overturetoosm.
why_useful: Alternative/duplicate cross-walk tool between Overture and OSM schemas; same rationale as above for reconciling lodging POI category definitions across sources.
themes: POI and place data: Overture Maps places, OSM extracts (tourism=*), Foursquare open places, Geofabrik tooling; counting STR/hotel supply from maps
why_all: Alternative/duplicate cross-walk tool between Overture and OSM schemas; same rationale as above for reconciling lodging POI category definitions across sources.

name: alperen-acikol/hud-crosswalk
what_it_holds: Python toolkit wrapping the HUD USPS Crosswalk API to map survey ZIP codes to county FIPS codes; a client/method rather than a stored dataset.
why_useful: One-command puller for ZIP-to-county FIPS mapping, a lighter-weight alternative to hosting the static crosswalk files, for regional-aggregation work on ZIP-level STR/registry data.
themes: Geocoding, neighbourhood boundaries and census-tract crosswalks used for STR studies; city GIS portals with STR layers
why_all: One-command puller for ZIP-to-county FIPS mapping, a lighter-weight alternative to hosting the static crosswalk files, for regional-aggregation work on ZIP-level STR/registry data.

name: Deep_XF
what_it_holds: Python package for building explainable forecasting/nowcasting models combining deep neural nets with Dynamic Factor Models on time-series panels, single-line-of-code API; also includes signal-similarity matching and denoising utilities.
why_useful: Another off-the-shelf DFM+deep-learning nowcasting library (gap #17) that could shortcut building a KPI nowcast pipeline for ABNB nights/ADR from a mixed panel of alt-data signals.
themes: Nowcasting methods and packages: MIDAS, dynamic factor models, bridge equations, nowcasting with Google Trends, KPI nowcasting for companies
why_all: Another off-the-shelf DFM+deep-learning nowcasting library (gap #17) that could shortcut building a KPI nowcast pipeline for ABNB nights/ADR from a mixed panel of alt-data signals.

name: Nowcasting-Python
what_it_holds: Python port/implementation of a nowcasting model (dynamic-factor/mixed-frequency style, per description "Python Nowcasting"); 135 stars but description is terse — needs closer inspection before relying on it.
why_useful: Potential lightweight Python DFM nowcasting implementation (gap #17) if it turns out to be a faithful port of the classic Giannone-Reichlin-Small model; flagged for follow-up rather than confirmed.
